seed_candidates.canon_label_hint: projection consumers and widget shell contract
exact_items: Orchestrator widgets should consume stable shared projections rather than raw event streams or bespoke queries
widget shell needs widget identity/type, scope, filter/sort/display config, projection ref
Run Summary, Seam Summary, Concern Summary, Account / Usage Pressure, Recent Major Events should be broadly reusable across Orchestrator / Dashboard / Projects
notes: Consumer carry-through expectation: shared projections must remain stable across surfaces, while only dense summaries stay Orchestrator-facing.

seed_candidates.canon_label_hint: record-backed trust anchor under stale projections
exact_items: Degrade from summary/projection surfaces to direct record-backed inspection
Ledger and direct record views become the trust anchor under degraded projection health
Only certain current/generation-matched direct records should support action
Direct record views that allow action should explicitly show currentness, generation match, superseded yes/no, actionable yes/no
heading_hints: Fallback path under stale projections is now clearer
notes: Consumer expectation: action gating must flow from freshness/currentness and be visible in the record view itself.

exact_items: Actions that change execution/promotion/recovery/approval truth require fresh-enough projection state
UI should explain gating inline: what is stale, why it matters, what the user can do next
Projection health becoming an operational concern must mint a real concern rather than stay a silent widget problem
heading_hints: Action-gating direction under degraded projections now clarified
notes: Layout blocker: action surfaces need explicit stale-state explanation and a fallback to record-backed inspection.

seed_candidates.canon_label_hint: concern record as first-class owned entity
exact_items: `concern` should be a first-class record, not just a field buried in review/alert logic
Concern records should carry identity, scope, severity, category, owner, lifecycle state, meaning/summary, linkage to evidence/artifacts/history/source records, visibility/attention flags
Canonical concerns should be created by runtime, package overseer, seam overseer, corroboration outcome, graph patch/state-transition logic
notes: Owner carry-through: workers may nominate findings but should not mint canonical concerns directly.

exact_items: All major surfaces should project the same concern model rather than inventing local versions
`Progress` = operational attention projection
`Seams` = integration/governance projection
`Evidence` = proof-backed concern projection
`History` = concern lifecycle timeline projection
`Ledger` = exact structured concern-record projection
heading_hints: Shared concern projection rule now clarified
notes: Consumer carry-through: all major surfaces must read the same underlying concern model with different projections.
